justification: Intelligence brief schema contract — every downstream stage builds on these types. Wrong null semantics or missing fields cascade into wrong data served to users.

pre_impl.existing_data: Inherits from conveyancing pipeline: controls dict, valuation dict, strata dict, overlays list, DAs list, shadow dict. All shapes validated against spike-results.json (20 real addresses).
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If upstream functions change return shapes (e.g. strata dict gains new fields), DataField wrappers pass through — no schema break. If fields are removed, compute_confidence_summary still walks correctly (ignores non-DataField attributes).
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Schema-only — no database writes. Models are consumed by Stage 2 orchestrator which will populate them from live API calls. Fixtures use realistic data from spike results.
pre_impl.external_source_error: Every external source error is handled by _safe_call wrapper: returns DataField(value=None, confidence=not_available, reason=error_string). Never raises. Never silently returns empty list as success.
pre_impl.frontend_type: Frontend types not yet created — Stage 2 will generate TypeScript types from these Pydantic models via model_json_schema().
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: If schema is wrong: wrong data served silently (worst case), or extra='forbid' catches unexpected fields at serialisation time (best case). All 4 fixture briefs validate the schema against real data shapes.

functions.name: classify_strata
functions.input: strata_info dict from detect_strata upstream function plus lot_area_m2 Optional[float] from VG API
functions.output: StrataType enum with four states — NOT_STRATA, APARTMENT, DEVELOPMENT, or AMBIGUOUS based on lot area thresholds
functions.if_none: None lot_area returns AMBIGUOUS (honest about uncertainty, not crash). Empty dict returns NOT_STRATA (is_strata defaults falsy).

functions.name: _zone_prefix
functions.input: Optional[str] zone string from parse_controls, e.g. 'R2 Low Density Residential' or None or empty
functions.output: str — uppercase zone prefix like 'R2' or 'RU2', or empty string on None/empty input
functions.if_none: None returns empty string. Empty string returns empty string. Whitespace-only returns empty string. Prevents the IndexError from empty-split.

functions.name: _safe_call
functions.input: Callable fn (zero-arg), str source_name for logging, ConfidenceLevel confidence_on_success for the result wrapper
functions.output: DataField — always returned, never raises. On success: value=fn() result with given confidence. On exception: value=None with not_available confidence and error reason.
functions.if_none: fn() returning None is a valid success (authoritative confidence preserved). fn() raising any Exception is caught and wrapped as not_available.

functions.name: _sanitise
functions.input: Optional[str] value from external API response (Planning Portal, ePlanning, Cadastre) that may contain HTML
functions.output: Optional[str] with all HTML tags stripped via regex, null bytes removed, and whitespace trimmed. None passthrough preserved.
functions.if_none: None input returns None (passthrough). Empty string returns empty string. Only-tags input returns empty string.

functions.name: compute_confidence_summary
functions.input: DevelopmentBrief or RenovationBrief instance — walks all nested fields recursively to find DataField instances
functions.output: ConfidenceSummary with integer counts per confidence level (authoritative, extracted, estimated, derived, not_available, stale) plus total
functions.if_none: Walks all fields recursively via Pydantic model_fields. Non-DataField attributes silently skipped. Empty brief results in total=0.

functions.name: collect_gaps
functions.input: DevelopmentBrief or RenovationBrief instance — walks all nested fields recursively to find not_available DataFields
functions.output: list[GapEntry] — one entry per DataField with confidence=not_available, including the dotted field path and reason string
functions.if_none: No not_available fields returns empty list. Recursively walks nested BaseModel instances and lists of BaseModels.

values.nullable: no — defaults to False via dict.get() falsy check
values.if_missing: Classified as NOT_STRATA — safe default (no development analysis skipped for non-strata)

values.nullable: yes — can be None from VG API failure or rural lots without valuation
values.guard_at: services/intelligence_brief.py:468 — if lot_area_m2 is not None
values.if_missing: Classified as AMBIGUOUS — honest about uncertainty rather than wrong classification

values.nullable: yes — portal may not return zone for some lot types
values.guard_at: services/intelligence_brief.py:489 — if not zone or not zone.strip()
values.if_missing: Returns empty string — no crash, no misleading value, downstream code handles empty gracefully

queries: N/A — schema-only stage, no database queries. Stage 2 will add query tracing.

break_it.scenario: Strata townhouse on 2140m2 parent lot classified as apartment instead of development-capable property
break_it.what_happens: User sees RenovationBrief (no DCP controls, no granny flat analysis) instead of DevelopmentBrief with full development potential
break_it.how: services/intelligence_brief.py:468 — four-state StrataType with AMBIGUOUS for 400-2500m2. Spike finding (Carlton Cres) drove this design.

break_it.scenario: Empty zone string from Planning Portal causes IndexError when code calls split on empty string and accesses index zero
break_it.what_happens: 500 error on any address where Planning Portal returns empty or missing zone field in the layerintersect response
break_it.how: services/intelligence_brief.py:489-492 — _zone_prefix guards against None, empty, whitespace. Returns empty string safely.

break_it.scenario: Non-numeric prop_id string like 'abc' or SQL injection attempt '1; DROP TABLE' causes unhandled ValueError from int() conversion
break_it.what_happens: 500 internal server error instead of 422 validation error — user sees generic crash instead of actionable message
break_it.how: services/intelligence_brief.py:185 — Pydantic Field(pattern=r'^\d{1,12}$') rejects non-numeric prop_id at request validation time before any code runs

break_it.scenario: PostGIS database down — overlay query fails, response looks like 'no environmental constraints' because empty list returned silently
break_it.what_happens: User sees clean environmental report when data was actually unavailable — dangerous false negative for flood/bushfire
break_it.how: services/intelligence_brief.py:146-167 — _safe_call catches exception, returns DataField(confidence=not_available). collect_gaps surfaces it. check_minimum_viable refuses brief if too many fields failed.

break_it.scenario: XSS payload in DA description from ePlanning API like '<script>alert(1)</script>' rendered in frontend without escaping
break_it.what_happens: Script execution in user's browser if frontend uses dangerouslySetInnerHTML on any string field from the brief
break_it.how: services/intelligence_brief.py:495-501 — _sanitise strips HTML tags and null bytes from all external API strings before including in response

break_it.scenario: Response includes undocumented field added by future code change that breaks the strict frontend TypeScript type contract
break_it.what_happens: Frontend TypeScript compilation error or runtime crash on unexpected field in the JSON response
break_it.how: DevelopmentBrief and RenovationBrief use model_config = ConfigDict(extra='forbid'). Pydantic raises ValidationError on any extra field during serialisation.

post_merge.manual_verify: No — all verification is automated via 86 unit tests
